common_name: Surf Break Hebe (Variegated Pink-Flowering Compact Hebe)

planting.note: Set container plants out in spring in well-drained soil; this compact hebe is well suited to pots and small-space plantings in mild climates.

directions: Surf Break is a Monrovia hebe selection (cultivar code 'HebAnn03') with creamy-yellow and green variegated foliage, which emerges with purple-pink new growth before soft pink flower spikes appear in summer and fall. Site in well-drained soil in full to partial sun. Once established this hebe tolerates light drought and needs only occasional watering.

common_name: Surf Swell Hebe (Silvery-Leaved Magenta-Flowering Compact Hebe)

planting.note: Set container plants out in spring in well-drained soil; pairs with Surf Break Hebe as a compact container or border selection for mild climates.

directions: Surf Swell is a Monrovia hebe (US Plant Patent PP32,585, cultivar 'HebAnn05', bred by Steve Burton in New Zealand) with green-grey, silvery foliage and purple-pink new growth. Bright magenta flower spikes appear from late summer into autumn, drawing pollinators to the compact mound. Grow in part to full sun and well-drained soil; mature plants need only light, occasional watering.
